title: Modern Masters
description: The turn into modernism — symbolism and expression at the dawn of the new century.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
items.description_narrative: Gustave Caillebotte's 'Paris Street; Rainy Day' captures a striking urban scene in 1877 Paris, depicting well-dressed figures strolling under umbrellas on a wet street. The composition offers a unique perspective of modern city life, characterized by its precise realism and distinctive viewpoints.
items.tags: urban life, street scene, rainy day, 19th century, realism, city, umbrellas, french art

items.title: Hercules and the Lernaean Hydra
items.description_narrative: Gustave Moreau's 'Hercules and the Lernaean Hydra' dramatically depicts the heroic figure surveying the slain multi-headed monster amid a landscape strewn with its victims. This powerful work exemplifies Moreau's Symbolist approach, rich with intricate details and a somber, mythical atmosphere.
items.tags: mythology, symbolism, hercules, hydra, french, heroic, dramatic, oil painting

items.title: Calf's Head and Ox Tongue
items.description_narrative: This painting presents a starkly realistic still life featuring a butchered calf's head and an ox tongue, rendered with unflinching detail. Gustave Caillebotte's meticulous brushwork captures the textures and forms of the meat, reflecting his mastery of realistic depiction.
items.tags: still life, realism, meat, food, detailed, oil painting, 19th century

items.title: Alpine Scene
items.description_narrative: Gustave Doré's 'Alpine Scene' from 1865 captures the majestic beauty of mountainous landscapes through oil on canvas. This painting exemplifies his ability to render dramatic natural environments with intricate detail and atmospheric depth.
items.tags: landscape, alpine, mountains, oil painting, 19th century, romanticism, french, sublime

items.title: Mère Grégoire
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet's 'Mère Grégoire' is an oil on canvas portrait depicting an older woman. This work exemplifies Courbet's commitment to portraying everyday people with directness and realism.
items.tags: portrait, woman, realism, french realism, direct, naturalistic, oil painting

items.title: The Rock of Hautepierre
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet's 'The Rock of Hautepierre' depicts a rugged natural landscape with a prominent rock formation. This oil on canvas exemplifies Courbet's commitment to Realism, capturing the unadorned beauty of the natural world.
items.tags: landscape, realism, nature, oil painting, rock formation, french art

items.title: An Alpine Scene
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet's "An Alpine Scene" captures a dramatic mountain landscape, rendered with the artist's characteristic impasto technique. This oil on canvas work from 1874 exemplifies his dedication to depicting natural subjects with unflinching realism.
items.tags: landscape, Realism, oil painting, French art, mountain, nature, alpine, Courbet

items.title: The Valley of Les Puits-Noir
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet's 'The Valley of Les Puits-Noir' depicts a rugged, unidealized landscape from his native Jura region in eastern France. Executed in oil on canvas, this work exemplifies his Realist approach, capturing nature with a somber palette and textured brushwork.
items.tags: landscape, realism, french art, 19th century, nature, valley, oil painting

items.title: Rêverie (Portrait of Gabrielle Borreau)
items.medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
items.description_narrative: This intimate portrait by Gustave Courbet depicts Gabrielle Borreau in a contemplative pose. Painted in 1862, the work captures a moment of quiet introspection.
items.tags: portrait, realism, 19th century, contemplative, figure study, oil painting, french art

items.title: Cliffs on the Sea Coast: Small Beach, Sunrise (Falaise au bord de la mer, vu Petite Plage, soleil levant)
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet captures the rugged beauty of a coastal scene in 'Cliffs on the Sea Coast: Small Beach, Sunrise.' This oil on canvas painting from 1865 depicts a dramatic interplay of light and shadow on the cliffs as the sun rises over the sea.
items.tags: seascape, landscape, realism, nature, cliffs, sunrise, oil painting

items.title: The Brook of Les Puits-Noir
items.description_narrative: Gustave Courbet captures the quiet solitude of a brook winding through a densely wooded landscape in Les Puits-Noir. This painting exemplifies his commitment to depicting unidealized nature with a robust, earthy palette.
items.tags: landscape, nature, brook, forest, realism, 19th-century art, tranquil

items.title: The Girl by the Window
items.description_narrative: Edvard Munch's The Girl by the Window captures a moment of introspection and quiet solitude. This work exemplifies the artist's exploration of psychological states through the depiction of figures in evocative settings.
items.tags: expressionism, symbolism, psychological, solitude, figure painting, norwegian art, fin de siècle

items.title: The Kiss
items.medium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas
items.description_narrative: A couple locked in an intimate embrace, cloaked in elaborate gold-patterned robes, kneeling in a flower-strewn meadow. Klimt's masterful use of gold leaf and ornamental motifs epitomizes his 'Golden Phase' and the height of the Vienna Secession movement.
items.tags: love, gold, art nouveau, couple, embrace, ornamental

items.title: The Scream
items.medium: Oil, tempera, pastel and crayon on cardboard
items.description_narrative: An agonized figure against a tumultuous orange sky, standing on a bridge. Widely interpreted as representing the universal anxiety of modern humanity. Munch described the inspiration as feeling an infinite scream passing through nature.
items.tags: scream, anxiety, expressionism, bridge, sunset, anguish
